subject: prd/local-work-tracker
statement: When asked to create a work item with a type, title, and optional body and signals, the tracker shall persist it as an inspectable local file and return a stable, unique, human-referenceable identifier that is never reused.
rationale: the atomic unit of work must be creatable and durably named
fit_criterion: 1,000 creates yield 1,000 distinct ids, each resolvable by a subsequent read; no id recurs after deletion
